payload.title: The change-intelligence agent's details.impact_map, which the request contract makes mandatory on every merged-PR review, is written to judgment-pipeline/change_intelligence/<request_id>.json and has no reader, so the beliefs, findings and fixtures it names as needing revalidation never change status
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judgment_bridge.py:609-620 (the accepted answer's impact_map is written to judgment-pipeline/<role>/<request_id>.json)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judgment_bridge.py:632-635 (after the write only the sibling defect_claims key of the same answer is consumed; impact_map goes no further)

aria-kernel/aria_kernel/pr_tracking.py:389-392 (the minted prompt tells the agent to return impact_map with beliefs_needs_revalidation, findings_needs_revalidation, fixtures_requires_rerun, confirmed_unchanged)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/pr_tracking.py:404-410 (must_satisfy id impact-map makes the key a hard obligation of every answer)
aria-kernel/tests/test_judgment_bridge_e2e.py:514-533 (the only test asserts that the file is written; no test or code reads it back)
payload.rule_violated: A produced artifact needs an owner that reads it (CLAUDE.md Architectural Approach tier 2: the correct behaviour is automatic; a paid agent output with no consumer is a declaration without enforcement).
payload.notes: Every merged ARIA PR mints up to three change_intelligence requests whose contract demands details.impact_map; the accepted answer is persisted under judgment-pipeline/change_intelligence/ and one agent_supporting_payload_persisted governance row. git grep at d716541239 for impact_map, beliefs_needs_revalidation and the persisted directory finds only the producer prompt, docstrings, the agent card, the writer and tests, so the agent's reading of couplings the glob match cannot see never changes a belief, finding or fixture. The only impact path that moves statuses is the kernel's glob map (pr_tracking.plan_new_merge_impact), so the per-merge agent spend buys nothing the kernel uses. Close condition: Either a reader turns each impact_map entry into the existing revalidation transitions (a test persists an impact_map naming a belief and asserts that belief reads needs_revalidation in the next change_intelligence phase; red today), or the key and its must_satisfy obligation leave the prompt and the agent card and a test pins their absence. Verified at origin/main d716541239.
